🇳🇵 Nepal Legal QA Benchmark V1
	


A grounded, citation-rich Question-Answer benchmark dataset covering 9 foundational Nepali law texts — in both English and Nepali (Devanagari) — for evaluating and fine-tuning legal AI systems.



	
		
		📖 Dataset Description
	

Nepal Legal QA Benchmark is a synthetic-but-grounded dataset of 4,328 instruction-following QA pairs generated from the full text of Nepal's most important statutes. reputation: A niche but valuable resource for Nepali legal QA, gaining attention for being citation-rich and bilingual, though adoption remains limited outside specialized legal/NLP groups.
